completion_criteria.crefine: all selected CRefine contracts occur exactly once and all required Proof theories seal against the exact generated Refine heap
completion_criteria.partial_campaign: any failed, skipped, or unsealed required Proof theory produces only a partial report
completion_criteria.refine: all selected Refine contracts occur exactly once and all required Refine Proof theories seal and clean-build
completion_criteria.success_claim: generated contract-owning Proof-theory layer composed with frozen parents and Support; never the entire seL4 proof repository

contract_selection_policy.rule: select a top-level lemma/theorem/corollary whose operation-style name ends in _corres, _ccorres, or _corresK (optionally primed), whose statement contains the corresponding relation, excluding generic framework plumbing declarations
contract_selection_policy.setting_b_classification: a theory with at least one selected contract is Proof; otherwise it is frozen Support

experimental_claim: With endpoints, parent sessions, zero-selected-contract Support theories, Proof file slots, contract ownership, and exact selected refinement contracts frozen, regenerate and compose the contract-owning Refine and CRefine Proof-theory layers without exposing their original human implementations.

forbidden_path_policy.m1_exact_inventory_rule: M1 must publish a private exact forbidden inventory containing every source path classified as a contract-owning Proof theory

model_backends.production_requirement: one audited call over the sanitized M4 payload, read-only empty working directory, complete provider event transcript, and zero tool events
model_backends.role: M4 evidence-citing candidate generation-priority edges; deterministic code emits the final schedule

model_backends.production_requirement: read-only sanitized working directory, complete provider event transcript, and zero forbidden tool events

allowed_source_classes: exact selected contract statements and contract-owned attributes
minimal contract-owned elaboration contexts required to preserve the exact proposition
forbidden_source_classes: original imports and bodies of classified contract-owning Proof theories
original helper names, statements, roles, order, consumers, dependencies, and export plans from those theories
stock human Refine or CRefine target heaps
unsealed, red, abandoned, future, or sibling-generation declarations
trust_boundary.human_comparison: allowed only after a generated artifact is frozen, in a separate comparison workspace, and never fed back into generation
